title: Practice 8: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Том был в ___ (выцветший) джинсах.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «джинсах»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We live in a society of democracy.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «обществе»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: На ___ (грушевый) дереве растёт груша.
exercises.prompt: Upon a pear tree grows a pear.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «дереве»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom was injured in a traffic accident.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «происшествии»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «холле»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do you understand military ranks?

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «веке»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «любви»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ведре»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Заперты магазины, закрыт бар, люди переговариваются на ___ (безопасный) расстоянии.
exercises.prompt: Shops are shut, the bar is closed and people speak to each other from a safe distance.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «расстоянии»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: At the rear of the procession was a strange-looking man in a straw hat.

exercises.q: More often, the rash appears in large folds of the skin and is very itchy.
exercises.ru: Чаще сыпь появляется в ___ складках кожи и сильно зудит.
